race.comment: PACIFIC GLAMOUR (9) ran a much better race when tried in front at Bendigo 12 days ago, finishing third on a heavy track. She is likely to strike similar track conditions here, and in a field with not much depth, she can go close to taking this out. DO IT NOW (7) was beaten by a wide draw at Moe when resuming from a spell, and from a superior draw, she can improve sharply so stick with her. DEEP JOY (14) finished third as the favourite at a Berrigan picnic meeting just over 2 weeks ago. This is not much tougher, and with the aid of a 2kg claim, she can run into the money again. EL SALTO (11) is a durable veteran who is more than capable of a top 4 finish in a field like this. CUMBOOGLE (1) can be competitive at this level. Keep safe.
